suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 describes unsafe deserialization in Kotlin build-cache metadata. SOCP ships only Kotlin JVM runtime artifacts transitively through Okio/OTel; it does not ship the Kotlin compiler or build-cache implementation. The project pins the latest stable Kotlin line (2.4.10) and must re-evaluate this narrow suppression when Kotlin 2.4.20 is GA.

CVE-2026-54285 is published for opentelemetry-js and its Node.js W3CBaggagePropagator. The Java opentelemetry-api and opentelemetry-sdk artifacts have no JavaScript baggage parser; this is a CPE mapping false positive and is limited to these two Java package URLs.
